name: io.github.antohins/seo-tools-mcp-ga4
title: SEO Tools: Google Analytics 4
description: Google Analytics 4: reports, traffic sources, landing pages, events, realtime (read-only).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client ID (Desktop app), shared with the gsc server.

environmentVariables.name: GA4_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token (obtained via ga4_oauth_start / ga4_oauth_finish).

environmentVariables.name: GA4_SA_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Path to a service-account JSON key (alternative to OAuth).

environmentVariables.name: GA4_OAUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port for the OAuth flow (default 8586).
